speechWordChallenge.howToPlayLetters:
1. Look at the large letter on the screen.
2. Tap the microphone button.
3. Say the letter clearly!
4. Complete all 10 rounds to earn 3 stars! ⭐
speechWordChallenge.howToPlayWords:
1. Look at the picture on the screen.
2. Think of the word (the answer is hidden!).
3. Tap the microphone and say the word aloud!
4. Complete all 10 rounds to earn 3 stars! ⭐
speechWordChallenge.introPromptLetters: Look at the letter and say it aloud!
speechWordChallenge.introPromptWords: Look at the picture, think of the word, and say it aloud!

languagePairMatch.title: Language Pair Match
languagePairMatch.subtitle: Language Adventure
languagePairMatch.instructions: Match words in {{source}} with their translations in {{target}}!
languagePairMatch.sameLanguageDesc: Your home and learning languages are the same. Please choose another language to play this game.
languagePairMatch.howToPlayDesc:
1. Tap a card on the left in your language.
2. Tap the matching translation on the right.
3. Match all pairs to advance to the next round!
languagePairMatch.sessionCompletePraise: Awesome job! You matched the language pairs!
